# National Disability Rights Network

> NDRN is the national advocacy network for Protection and Advocacy (P&A) and Client Assistance Programs (CAP) fighting for civil rights, equal access, and community integration for people with disabilities.

The National Disability Rights Network (NDRN) represents the Protection and Advocacy Network across all 50 states and territories. NDRN and its member P&A organizations advocate on critical issues including employment, housing, education, healthcare, and criminal justice reform to ensure people with disabilities have equal rights and access to community life.

## Key Topics

- Protection and Advocacy (P&A) Network
- Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)
- Civil Rights
- Community Integration
- Independent Living
- Disability Rights Advocacy
- Legal Protection
- Client Assistance Programs (CAP)
- Equal Access
- Discrimination Prevention
- Higher Education Access
- Disability Pride
- Legal Advocacy
- Advocacy Networks

## Core Issues & Advocacy

- [ADA & Civil Rights](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/ada-civil-rights): Americans with Disabilities Act overview and civil rights protections
- [Community Integration](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/community-integration): NDRN advocacy for community integration and deinstitutionalization
- [Employment](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/employment): NDRN employment advocacy for fair pay and job access for disabled people
- [Education](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/education): NDRN advocacy for equitable education and student disability rights
- [Housing](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/housing): NDRN advocacy for accessible affordable housing and independent living

## Health & Wellness

- [Health Care](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/health-care): NDRN advocacy for Medicare, Medicaid, and Affordable Care Act
- [Mental Health](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/mental-health): P&A Network mental health advocacy and patient rights protection

## Justice & Safety

- [Justice System](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/justice-system): NDRN criminal justice reform and correctional advocacy for disabled people
- [Hate Incidents](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/hate-incidents): NDRN hate crimes prevention and survivor legal resources advocacy
- [Fires, Disasters & Emergencies](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/fires-disasters-emergencies): P&A Network disaster preparedness and emergency response advocacy

## Access & Mobility

- [Transportation](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/transportation): NDRN and P&A advocacy for accessible transportation systems

## Special Populations & Programs

- [Veterans](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/veterans): NDRN and P&A Network advocacy for veterans with disabilities
- [Representative Payees](https://www.ndrn.org/issues/representative-payees): NDRN and P&A monitoring of Social Security representative payees

## About NDRN

- [National Disability Rights Network](https://www.ndrn.org): NDRN homepage: national disability rights advocacy network for P&As and CAPs
